Results.ReviewText: I've had this grill for about a month now, using it many times in the warm weather, and while I like it quite a bit, I am concerned it may be unstable. This past week I was grilling several brats with the grill full of charcoal, and the entire thing rolled right off of my deck, throwing the charcoal, food, and parts of the grill. I've set it up at a different angle now in case my deck is crooked, but I'll admit I'm concerned.
Results.Title: Maybe good, maybe unstable?

Results.ReviewText: As mentioned in the title this is my 2nd purchase of the Weber kettle. Quality and toughness are unchanged from my 1st. I am very happy with the Weber product and did not even consider an alternative when it was time for a new one. I highly recommend this product.
Results.Title: 1st one lasted 20+ years so bought another.

Results.ReviewText: After 20 plus years of charcoal grilling and smoking I finally purchased a Weber grill. I usually use a charcoal grill/smoker combination unit. After my second unit I've owned recently went to the curb I decided to go to a dedicated smoker and a dedicated grill. I searched out a few charcoal grills and remembered a friend telling me how he enjoyed his Weber grill. It was the only grill he used. So I bit the bullet and purchased my first Weber and glad I did. The ease of assembly,use and clean up are awesome. It's great at holding heat. I have received numerous compliments on the color. The only thing I'm worried about is the thin metal on the legs.
Results.Title: My first Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love it. I do wish there was more guidance for utilizing the air flow on the bottom of the grill. I find it challenging gaging how open/closed it should be when grilling different foods. But, I do feel that everytime I use it, that I gain a better understanding. I absolutely love seeing the smoke pouring out of the closed grill...just working it's tail off. I respect and admire the grill's work ethic.
Results.Title: Love to See It Work

Results.ReviewText: Nothing like a weber!!  Time-tested design, high-quality parts, and phenomenal customer service.
Results.Title: Weber is the best way to go!

Results.ReviewText: 2 weeks old, spot on grill top (black porcelain cover) is already rusting. Very disappointing as I have kept in a covered area and only taken out when using.
Results.Title: Great Grill, One Issue

Results.ReviewText: The grill was easy to assemble.   The construction material of the grill is well-made and high-quality.  I love the easy to detach  charcoal disposal bowl.  This is my new favorite grill.
Results.Title: Highly recommended  BBQ!!!

Results.ReviewText: Love my weber premium kettle! I've been using almost every weekend since it arrived.
Results.Title: Buy a Kettle

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect size for a family with the 22" grilling surface.  I like how the grate folds in to add charcoal or wood chips below.  The grate is also at the right size to fit the dishwasher for quick cleaning.  This is a very sturdy product that even had a video to walk you through assembly which made it very easy.  Love this product and the warranty that comes with it!
Results.Title: Heavy Duty Family Grill

Results.ReviewText: With everything going on in the world i realzed it would take a little longer to get my grill.  I finally received it and was so excited.   Went to put it together and was missing the triangle piece on the bottom.   Called customer service on hold for 30 minutes,  understood they are probably limited staff, left several emails, no response,  ok again understand probably gets 1000s emails,  so just ordered the part myself paid for it and paid the extra for 2 day shipping.   Well all in all love my Weber,  will have to adjust how much charcoal i use cuz it gets soooooo much hotter then my other bbq...but i am so glad i invested in a weber instead of a cheaper one.
Results.Title: Love my new Weber

Results.ReviewText: Weber has been our go-to charcoal grill for generations. Great quality - never lets us down.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Holds heat perfect. Love the easy spent coal dump. Folding grill edges make it easy to move coal around.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: This grill was a piece of cake to put together- Weber actually directed me to a step by step interactive page that showed how. And it’s an absolute pleasure to cook on! The easy to remove, covered ash bin makes cleanup simple
Results.Title: Easy to assemble and great for grilling

Results.ReviewText: Works great. There a few minor thing that I wish were different such as the lid resting at a full 90 degrees and more accessories available in store instead of online.and I wish there a more of a color selection other than black.  Not so bad that I have to take away stars so I still give a 5 star rating due to great customer service.
Results.Title: Great but not perfect

Results.ReviewText: This is an excellent all purpose charcoal grill that is well-designed and makes grilling easy. It is generally rugged. My only criticism is that the legs and wheels are a bit flimsy making it awkward to move. For the price it’s a great value.
Results.Title: Great value

Results.ReviewText: New to charcoal grilling, and I believe time tells truth. This grill has been around so long, and I know it will last a long time. It cooks very consistently, and with about 14 uses I cannot wait to do more. Chicken quarters, bone in pork chops, ribeyes, and burgers and brats have been amazingly flavorful and juicy. I cannot wait to do a slow cook of brisket or ribs. Well built and easy to assemble, I highly recommend this without a doubt.
Results.Title: Very nice

Results.ReviewText: Fabulous and economical way to begin the journey of becoming an expert grill master!
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: This was such an exciting purchase and has lived up to the solid reputation. I grill out year round every week, and this meets my expectations. Also, having a reliable temperature gage on top is very helpful for those longer cooking meats like ribs or shoulders. The edges of the cooking grate food up so you can add more wood or charcoal during the cookout. The enclosed, removable ash collector is so much better than the cheaper option that fills up with water and blows everywhere. Enjoy!
Results.Title: Well worth the price and a striking color choice

Results.ReviewText: This is the first charcoal grill I’ve owned and I’m upset I waited all this time to buy a Weber.  The ease of cleaning the grill, the heat retention and design of the grill is everything you need.  Every chance free chance I get I fire him up to grill or smoke meats.  Easily my best purchase of 2020 so far.
Results.Title: Everything you need!

Results.ReviewText: Good grill overall, but could have put the temp gage closer to the top vent.
Results.Title: Temp gage in better position

Results.Title: Perfect charcoal grill!

Results.ReviewText: It’s been great. Loving it. Great size. Solid build. Maybe consider actual screws or nuts and bolts to use on the wheels - right now it’s made up of questionable little pieces of plastic
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: I loved my old basic Weber 17 inch charcoal grill and bought this because I am now putting the grill on a deck and wanted the more convenient ash removal feature.  As anticipate, I am pleased with my new grill & also like being able to hang the cover on the grill while using it.
Results.Title: Very happy with my new grill

Results.ReviewText: Love my new COPPER Weber 22" Original Kettle Premium! This is my fourth Weber, I have a Smokey Joe too-- I gave away two older Webers (still working!) to friends when I upgraded.  Great features like the ash-catcher, temp gauge, and heat shield--wish it had a LID DAMPER HANDLE (see picture) like the Master Touch series (not offered in Copper color)-- maybe Weber will send me one for this review and my suggestions for improvements?  I did make one small change/improvement by replacing the small black leg cap with a better one that is angled so it sits flat on the ground, and doesn't wear down, break and fall off (like the white one did on my previous One-Touch) If I can put my two-cents in on one other thing--- I think it's a mistake to only put one handle on the bowl instead of two (I was really lucky and found a 2018 two-handled model) sometimes you need to move the (hot or not) grill over uneven surfaces where wheels won't work, and those two handles come in REAL handy.  I'm sure "cost-cutting" is what the bean-counters say, but I say "HAPPY CUSTOMERS are repeat customers, and they tell their friends about a good product."
Results.Title: Sooooooo close to perfect, but....

Results.ReviewText: I have had the black kettle for years and said what the heck let’s get a OU color!
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: My parents first owned a Weber since 1960’s.  They’re the best and I now own two!  Assembled newest one for my cabin in 23 minutes!
Results.Title: Weber Girl Forever

Results.ReviewText: I have been wanting this Grill for 5 years! Its so strong and sturdy. I love how I can add charcoal, and hang the lid on the side, the ash holder is great. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because the ash holder is difficult to insert and remove for me. It has two metal prongs that you have to squeeze to insert and remove the bottom bowl. I'm a 50 yr female ( but still the Grill-master in this house) and have a hard time with it. I'm sure men will have no issues with this because of strength. My husband said it was also simple to put together.  My steaks turn out way better than any expensive steakhouse on this!! you won't regret spending the extra for quality.
Results.Title: Female Grill Master

Results.ReviewText: Best purchase I have made in a very long time! Making wings, burgers, shrimp and all kinds of other tasty foods.
Results.Title: Amazing product!

Results.ReviewText: Excellent purchase. Haven't used my gas grill since.

ClientResponses.Response: Hello Gary, we do not paint our grills therefore there should not be any paint peeling from your lid. That peeling substance is just a build-up of carbon. To clean it off, simply take a brush or ball of aluminum foil and gently scrape the carbon off the lid. Please let us know if there is anything else we can assist you with! Thanks!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill/smoker, easy setup, holds temp very well
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium is great

Results.ReviewText: Amazing piece of equipment! Quality built grill. It has handled everything I could throw at it!! NEVER GONNA OWN ANYTHING EXCEPT A WEBBER!!!
Results.Title: TOP SHELF QUAILTY!!!

Results.ReviewText: It was moderately difficult to put together, most likely because the legs were slightly bent out of shape. The first time I used it, I followed the directions to let the fire burn 30 minutes before cooking. The fire got really hot but by the time the 30 minutes was up, the charcoal was consumed and the food didn't get cooked. Disaster. Next time I will use more charcoal and start cooking as soon as the coals are ready. I have had several of these grills in the past so am not a novice.
Results.Title: Use way more charcoal the first time.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
